summary: This standards-track RFC describes a YANG library listing all YANG modules used by a network management server, such as a NETCONF server. It provides simple caching so clients can avoid re-fetching the information. It was replaced by RFC 8525.

eli5.summary: A table of contents telling a client which data models a device supports. This version was replaced by RFC 8525.

questions: how to list yang modules on a netconf server
